title: Lightweight refractory high entropy alloys with excellent specific strength and enhanced malleability by in-situ heterogeneous structure
process_description: prepared by mechanical alloying using Ti, Al, Cr, Mo, and V powders (30:1 ball-to-powder ratio, 400 rpm, 30 h, argon atmosphere), consolidated by spark plasma sintering (1200°C, 5 min, 40 MPa)
